verdict.rationale: sevDesk's own docs say it connects business bank accounts, supporting over 4,000 banks and neobanks, and matches invoices to bank payments, which implies bank transactions flow into the bookkeeping. Nothing in the evidence mentions credit-card accounts or says transactions import automatically on a daily schedule. Missing for 10: credit-card account connections, documented automatic daily transaction sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Seamlessly merge your business account and bookkeeping and pay your invoices directly from sevdesk. We already support over 4,000 banks and neobanks.
Map invoices directly to your bank payments.
